items.q: What is an Annual Maintenance Contract?
items.a: An Annual Maintenance Contract is an agreement covering the maintenance and technical support of specified equipment over an agreed period.

items.q: Which devices can be covered under an AMC?
items.a: Laptops and desktop computers can be considered for coverage. Other IT equipment may be included if supported and listed in the agreement.

items.q: Do you provide AMC services in Bangalore?
items.a: Yes. Contact Renton Technologies to discuss IT maintenance requirements in Bangalore. Availability depends on the location and requested services.

items.q: Is on-site support included in an AMC?
items.a: On-site support may be available depending on the selected plan, location, and agreed contract terms.

items.q: Are spare parts included in AMC charges?
items.a: Spare-parts coverage depends on the agreement. Components and certain repairs may incur additional charges unless explicitly included.

items.q: How much does an AMC cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on equipment quantity, device types, maintenance requirements, service frequency, and coverage.

items.q: How can I request an AMC quotation?
items.a: Contact our team with your business location, equipment inventory, and support requirements to discuss a suitable quotation.
